title: Measuring Privacy Risks and Tradeoffs in Financial Synthetic Data Generation
summary: The official research codebase for a paper studying privacy risks and tradeoffs in generating synthetic financial tabular data, including custom model implementations and evaluation pipelines. It builds directly on SDV: sdv.single_table's CTGANSynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer are trained and sampled for data generation, sdv.metadata.Metadata defines schemas, sdmetrics' QualityReport/DiagnosticReport/LogisticDetection score fidelity and privacy, sdgym is imported for benchmarking, and the standalone ctgan package's internals (DataSampler, DataTransformer, CTGAN/Discriminator/Generator) are extended into a custom iterative CTGAN variant.
